newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Gunmen spray dance in Kingston, kill four.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen spray dance in Kingston, kill four.

text.p: Gunmen jumped from a car and sprayed a crowd at a Kingston dance with bullets, killing four people, police said on Friday.
The victims were two men and two women. Three people were wounded, including a 14-year-old boy who was fighting for his life in a hospital.
Police said they knew of no motive for the shooting at Cockburn Gardens on Thursday night.
It took to 175 the number of murders in Jamaica this year. A record 921 people were killed in Jamaica last year, mostly in the slums of Kingston and nearby Spanish Town.
